StitchesPatchworkCreation.name: Patchwork Creation
StitchesPatchworkCreation.description: Gain 3 Armor for every unit afflicted with Vile Gas, stacking up to 8 times. While Shambling Horror is active, this Armor amount is doubled. Passive: Increase regeneration effects and all healing received by 15%.

StitchesSavortheFlavorDevour.name: Savor The Flavor
StitchesSavortheFlavorDevour.description: Quest: Hitting an enemy Hero with Devour increases Stitches' Health Regeneration by 1.5 and the damage of Vile Gas by 2%, stacking up to 100 times.

StitchesHungryforMore.name: Hungry for More
StitchesHungryforMore.description: Gain 5% Movement Speed. Quest: Gathering a Regeneration Globe increases Stitches's maximum Health by 25. Reward: Every 20 Globes gathered permanently increases Stitches' Movement Speed by an additional 5%.

StitchesPlaytime.name: Playtime!
StitchesPlaytime.description: Basic Attacks reduce the cooldown of Slam by 0.75 seconds and restores 5 Mana. Hitting Heroes with the inner area of Slam reduces its cooldown by 1.5 seconds.

StitchesVileCleaver.name: Vile Cleaver
StitchesVileCleaver.description: Basic Attacks against enemies with Vile Gas deal 35% more damage and spreads Vile Gas to nearby enemies. Passive: Slam applies Vile Gas to all targets hit.

StitchesTenderizer.name: Tenderizer
StitchesTenderizer.description: Basic Attacks against enemy Heroes Slow by 20% for 1.5 seconds and restore 1.75% of Stitches' maximum Health.

StitchesSerratedEdge.name: Serrated Edge
StitchesSerratedEdge.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook deals bonus damage equal to 5% of their maximum Health, reduces Hook's cooldown by 4 seconds, and restores 35 Mana.

StitchesSecondHelping.name: Second Helping
StitchesSecondHelping.description: Devour gains 1 additional charge with a 6 second cooldown between uses. Gambit: If Stitches is at max Health after using Devour, he gains a Shield equal to 15% of his maximum Health for 10 seconds. Every death, reduce this Shield by 3%.

StitchesPutrefaction.name: Putrefaction
StitchesPutrefaction.description: While Shambling Horror is active, Vile Gas reduces healing received by 40%. Passive: Vile Gas heals Stitches for 75% of the damage dealt.

StitchesHeroicAbilityPutridBile.name: Putrid Bile
StitchesHeroicAbilityPutridBile.description: Emit bile that deals 37 (+4% per level) damage per second to enemies within, Slowing them by 35% for 1.5 seconds. Gain 20% Movement Speed while emitting bile. Lasts 8 seconds.

StitchesHeroicAbilityGorge.name: Gorge
StitchesHeroicAbilityGorge.description: Consume an enemy Hero, trapping them for 4 seconds. When Gorge ends, the enemy Hero takes 274 (+4% per level) damage. The trapped Hero cannot move or act and doesn't take damage from other sources.

StitchesMeatHook.name: Meat Hook
StitchesMeatHook.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook heals Stitches for 20% of his maximum Health over 5 seconds. While active, Basic Attacks against the Hero hit refresh the duration of this effect.

StitchesUnderPressure.name: Under Pressure
StitchesUnderPressure.description: Increase Slam's damage by 25. Quest: After damaging Heroes with Vile Gas 6 times, permanently increase the damage of Slam by 1, to a maximum of 75 additional damage.

StitchesChopChop.name: Chop Chop
StitchesChopChop.description: Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook or activating Shambling Horror grants 40% increased Attack Speed for 4 seconds. Basic Attacks refresh the duration of this effect.

StitchesPulverizeSlam.name: Pulverize
StitchesPulverizeSlam.description: All enemies hit by Slam are Slowed by 70% for 0.75 seconds and Heroes have their Armor reduced by 10 for 3 seconds.

StitchesDigestiveJuices.name: Digestive Juices
StitchesDigestiveJuices.description: Devour deals an additional 140 (+4% per level) damage over 5 seconds. When used on a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds and causes the Hero hit to deal 50% reduced damage for 4 seconds.

StitchesFlareUp.name: Flare Up
StitchesFlareUp.description: Deals 15 (+4% per level) damage per second to nearby enemies. Hitting an enemy Hero with Hook or activating Shambling Horror increases this damage by 150% for 4 seconds.

StitchesGiftFromTheEmbalmer.name: Gift From The Embalmer
StitchesGiftFromTheEmbalmer.description: Putrid Bile deals 100% more damage to Heroes. Quest: Each time Putrid Bile damages an enemy Hero, the duration of Stitches' next death timer is reduced by 2%, to a maximum of 80% total reduction. All stacks of this effect are lost upon death.

StitchesHungryHungryStitchesGorge.name: Hungry Hungry Stitches
StitchesHungryHungryStitchesGorge.description: For 4 seconds after using Gorge, Stitches can teleport a short distance to additional targets and Gorge them. Enemies are Slowed by 75% for 1 second after Gorge ends.

StitchesHookMasterHooker.name: Master Hooker
StitchesHookMasterHooker.description: Reduce the cooldown of Hook by 4 seconds. Enemy Heroes hit by Hook have 75% reduced healing for 2 seconds. Allies hit by Helping Hand are Unkillable for 2 seconds.

StitchesGasBag.name: Gas Bag
StitchesGasBag.description: Activating Shambling Horror grants Unstoppable for 3 seconds. Passive: Shambling Horror's cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.
